outcome: Suspicion of poor fetal growth leading to expedited delivery
cohort: Preterm infants born at 24.0 to 36.9 weeks gestation in Victoria, Australia, from 2005 to 2015 (n=28,968)
finding: While all fetal growth charts classified a greater proportion of preterm and stillborn infants as SGA compared to birthweight charts, INTERGROWTH identified a smaller but higher-risk cohort, and GROW customised charts classified the largest number of infants at increased risk of perinatal mortality.
